messages:
lee: hitting a weird generator resume race in the go sampleapp during token refresh. stream never returns after retry.

maria: quick summary? sounds like the auth-retry/ctx cancel interplay we've seen.

lee: reproduce: long stream, token TTL expires, client starts retry+reconnect; server sometimes acks the old stream late and client blocks waiting on frames from resumed stream.

alex: probable cause: no stable resume id and client abandons original before confirming resumed frames.

sam: short-term: make StartGeneratorStream listen to ctx.Done and close underlying conn immediately. long-term: add resume_id metadata so server can merge duplicates.

maria: agree. also add handshake timeout so a lost start doesn't hang.

lee: opened draft PR with resume_id opt + small handshake timeout and unit test. https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/4340

ci-bot: PR #4340 CI queued :hourglass:

alex: add a sampleapp quickstart note about long-lived streams + token rotation. users trip on this when using cloud VPNs.

sam: will add e2e that forces token expiry mid-stream.

maria: good plan. thanks for the quick fix.
